audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Cho'Gath levels 3, 4-5 and first item and Skill level 2, while whys[1] through whys[5] all say Mordekaiser is favoured through exactly those stages.
audit.why: The chart disagreed with its own why column on five rows. The packet levelChart and the chogath-side audit both read Skill / Mordekaiser x5 / Cho'Gath, and a 54.24% win rate over 561 games backs it.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Cho'Gath in matched full+content pairs — the same atomic group the mirror proposed — with ratings rescaled and phases[6].why rewritten to state why he takes the late game.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed Rupture twice, once as "Rupture (Knockup)" and once plainly, and neither entry carried a number. Feral Scream and Feast appeared nowhere in the cooldown surfaces.
audit.why: Rupture is 6s at 950 range, Feral Scream 11s at 300, Feast 80s at rank 1 — the whole engage plan turns on those three timers.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around Rupture and Feral Scream with their real numbers; dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and the three donts now carry them too.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream silences, and a silence stops Realm of Death being cast at all — the page mentioned the silence only as a don’t-header with a generic description under it. The delayed ground-crack tell on Rupture was also never described.
audit.why: Riot’s W text says it silences enemies in a cone; the Q text says it ruptures the ground at a target location, which is the beat you walk out of.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t say never to be mid-R when Feral Scream lands; dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns describe the ground-crack tell.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Cho'Gath's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Feast is true damage on an 80s cooldown and it ignores your W heal entirely, and a fully stacked Cho'Gath is a wall you cannot solo. Bring your team and let them eat the knockup.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Rupture (Knockup): matchup-defining — Telegraphed. Dodge it, then R. Track it before every engage. - Cho'Gath Rupture: Delayed ground spike that knocks up and slows — telegraphed. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath Rupture: matchup-defining — 6s and 950 range, but the ground cracks before it pops, so walk out. - Cho'Gath Feral Scream: 11s, a 300-range cone that silences — eat it before you commit R.

edits.before: Telegraphed. Dodge it, then R. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 6s at 950 range but telegraphed — walk out of it, then commit.

edits.before: That is Cho'Gath's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Rupture cracks the ground before it pops, and the tell is a full beat long.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Feral Scream is a 300-range cone; silenced, you cannot cast R at all.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Feast is 80s at rank 1 and deals true damage that ignores your shield entirely — deny his minion stacks and never let him free-cast it on the wave.

edits.before: Track Cho'Gath's Rupture (Knockup): Telegraphed. Dodge it, then R. When it is down — R him — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Rupture: 6s, 950 range, telegraphed. Feral Scream silences in a 300 cone — never be mid-R when it lands.

notes: Feast: three fields (whys[6], spikes[3].text, late) call it percent-max-HP true damage. Riot’s R text says only "a high amount of true damage" — the percent-health read comes from a derived flag, not the description — so everything I wrote says true damage without the percent claim, and I left the existing three fields alone rather than assert either way. Recorded in unverified. Rupture also carries a derived grounding flag that the description (pops enemies into the air) does not support; I wrote it as a knockup throughout, matching the chogath-side call. Mordekaiser Q’s grounding flag likewise not asserted.
